For creative batches: have Claude publish a selectable canvas of all variants, pick favorites, then build from favorites
Reuse the same flow for shareable lead-magnet galleries with prompts under each example

relevance.why: The pattern (agent publishes a review surface; you annotate; agent reads annotations) is strong for async review from a phone. Haji's Claude Code already has Artifacts with comments that do this natively, so here.now is a parallel tool rather than a need.

implement_score.why: Adopt the workflow, not the tool: standardize 'publish a review artifact with per-item comment slots' for creative/video/batch outputs using the built-in Artifact + ArtifactComments. Zero new accounts; an afternoon to template.

gap.what: New tool (here.now by Vercel) and a new technique: agent-built review pages with timestamped comments as the feedback loop for Claude-edited video and bulk creative selection. Liked set only had open-slide's comment-to-edit loop for slides.

verify: Does here.now exist as a Vercel product with an agent API/skill, and what does it cost?
Is Remotion the actual renderer (log only implies it)?
